note: Two legato-trills side by side, fingers 1 and 3 then 2 and 4, at one tempo so the weaker pair shows. The old tempo stages are now moves (72 to 96 bpm), and the one extra line is the goal: both pairs as even as each other.

exercise.title: Hammer and pull, both finger pairs
exercise.why: Trilling fingers 1 and 3, then 2 and 4, at the same tempo puts the two pairs side by side, so you hear which one hammers weaker and needs the practice.

cells.text: Press Play on the first tab below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}. Pick the first note once, then trill fingers 1 and 3 with hammer-ons and pull-offs, one note per beat.

Then press Play on the second tab below and do the same with fingers 2 and 4.
Practice until both pairs sound the same, every hammered note as loud as the picked one; the pair whose hammered notes are quieter is the one to play more.
